title: Ariyo
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhākkhayāya || katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhadomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || [page 167] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 167 4. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyā ti || ||
